name: zenith-ui-monorepo
description: Zenith UI — a dark-first React component library, plus its documentation site.

scripts.build: npm run build -w zenith-ui-kit && npm run build -w web
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n lib,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w zenith-ui-kit" "npm run dev -w web"
